finding: Outbound ASA proxy-facing tuples appear reversed versus client-origin Zeek tuples

representative_asa.record: Built outbound TCP connection ... dmz:10.10.3.20/8080 ... to inside:10.10.1.35/59155

source_native_semantics: Cisco documents ASA 302013 outbound as a connection initiated from the inside. Cisco's official NAT example logs an inside client-to-outside server flow as 'Built outbound' with the outside server listed first and the inside client second. Reversed address order is therefore expected for this ASA outbound representation.
generator_semantics: CiscoAsaEmitter._emit_built selects (responder, originator) when direction is outbound; _connection_direction derives direction from configured interface security levels. The emitted ASA tuple is the source-native projection, while canonical Zeek keeps the originator/responder orientation.
disposition: No tuple/context/emitter change. The reviewer compared two source-native direction conventions as if they were both originator-oriented.
